_readme: HARDGATE batch-bump ledger. THE RULE: every app update ships a NEW batch number and all five surfaces move together. This file is the record of which batches shipped; tests/test-batch-bump-discipline.mjs fails when build-stamp.js carries a version not listed here, or when the LAST entry is not the live version. WHY A LEDGER: a pure consistency check passes when you edit a module and bump nothing (the tree is consistent on the OLD number) - it catches drift WITHIN a bump, not a MISSING one. Append-only; the guard reads the last entry. TO SHIP: pick the next free number, move build-stamp.js (version + built), sw.js HG_CACHE, trendtable.js (header comment AND the trendtable-src-* loader ?v=), hg-api-base.js (data-v AND the shivagold/shiva-nav ?v=), and every index.html ?v= pin, then append {version, built, note} here.

batches.note: OMNIBTC tape-regime stand-down; version triad repaired (trendtable.js and hg-api-base.js had been left behind by a merge, which serves stale trendtable parts from cache)
upstream: RSI cross and liquidity sweep vote; EMA stack does not
upstream: OMNIBTC accuracy verdict made honest end to end
upstream: OMNIBTC smart-dollar spread leg, record bank plus two
upstream: OMNIBTC settlement and flow legs reworked, accuracy verdict end to end

merged upstream hg-v1301 (OMNIBTC: settlement/flow legs and the accuracy verdict end to end, plus the Coinbase BTC-USD spot cross-check); upstream had independently reused the hg-v1301 number for its own change, so per the batch rule this pack takes the next free number and records BOTH. Also allowlists api.coinbase.com in the connect-src in scripts/server.mjs AND vercel.json, which upstream dialled without permitting (the same unreachable-host defect class that has now shipped three times). Batch-bump discipline (data/batch-ledger.json + tests/test-batch-bump-discipline.mjs) is retained through the merge.

OMNIBTC CONFIRMATORY SETUP: the independent-evidence verdict the desk already computed is now assembled and shown. crossValidation and accuracyScore were written on every candidate and read NOWHERE (3 write sites, 0 read sites), and the six weighted contributions existed only as inline score += lines, so no reader could tell which evidence confirmed a crown. The weights are now ONE TABLE (hgObtcAccuracyParts) whose sum IS the score, and hgObtcConfirmatoryRead/Html render it: what confirmed, what disagreed, and what was never read. Readout only - no weight added, no threshold moved, cannot mint or demote. Also fixed a null-coercion defect found while building it: +null === 0 and isFinite(0) is true, so an ABSENT accuracyScore silently read as a real zero.

SETUP CONFIRM now reads the TAPE. The desk own header said it never fetches market data of its own, so CONFIRMED only ever meant "several desks agree" and nothing on the tab had looked at the candles those desks read. Added cfCandleContext: a pure, three-state read of the repo ONE candle seam (W.getCandles, the same one book.js and brain.js use), disclosing range position, tape lean vs the direction, ATR expansion, last-bar volume participation, wrong-ended EXTENDED entries and whether the last closed bar finished with the direction. Readout only - adds no weight and cannot promote, demote or block; fails open on every path and is bounded to 8 symbols with a 6s per-read timeout.

upstream: rebuilt the CANDLE FORECAST engine on real estimators and added its first guard; Candle Forecast prints an actionable TP/SL bracket; CRITICAL fix - goldind.js did not parse at all (stray brace), so the Candle Forecast tab and every gold desk were dead
upstream: one unopposed candle read is a long or short with stop and targets

upstream: a split candle tape still calls a side with stop and targets; candle forecast leans only when two reads agree. Also carries this branch: SETUP CONFIRM reads historical candles (cfCandleContext, three-state, readout only) and three CSP-blocked news hosts permitted

PARSE REPAIRS on two modules index.html actually loads, both corrupted by earlier commits. gold-scalp.js (HG_GoldScalpEngine) had NEVER parsed: commit 94350044 collapsed a block onto one line, dropped a closing brace, and left a setup.direction test against "long" on a BEAR setup plus a reference to an out-of-scope adr. gold-core-engine.js instantiates that engine for the gold judas read, so that read has silently failed inside its try/catch since that commit - a try/catch no test covered. Restored from the last revision that parses (dd7a40ad), keeping the one legitimate intent: the ATR stop factor 0.40 to 0.50. ganesh-gold.js carried a stray shell artifact, an orphaned duplicate function body that did not parse, a dead stub returning "test", and was missing its IIFE closer. Both repaired; all 229 standalone top-level modules now parse.

CANDLE FORECAST: the engine the guard documents now exists, and the tab renders. goldind.js goldCandleForecast was rebuilt to its documented spec - a shrunk drift with |t| >= 1 replacing the one-bar EMA9 tick, the empirical 60th percentile of the last 100 true ranges replacing atr * 0.8, a Parkinson-plus-ATR volatility blended through a bounded EWMA, a bounded |t| strength replacing the fabricated confidence field, a 30-bar floor, and an honest NEUTRAL third state that carries NO levels. A tape that cannot be measured returns null; a readable tape whose drift is inside the noise band returns NEUTRAL. Found while doing it: a tie of ZEROES was being broken as if it were a tie, so a dead-flat tape was handed BULL because 100 >= 100, with a stop and two targets attached. Also repaired the other guard, whose sandbox named its helpers _atr/_ema while the body it lifts calls atr/ema - so every assertion in it measured the absent-helper path. gold-candle-forecast.js: the double-mount guard asked for a class the module never creates, and any querySelector-based guard fires on the FIRST mount in a shell whose querySelector is a permissive stub - the tab rendered nothing ("blank: candle-forecast"). Now guarded on module state. gold-formation.js: the CANDLE FORECAST tab is classified in the gold census, measured as a non-minter (no ticket, no forward record, no levels).

GOLD SCALP WAS FORMING ZERO CANDIDATES ON EVERY SCAN, and one free variable was the cause. __goldBundle in goldind.js read `dir` at its macro read - a variable that is not a parameter of that function and is never declared in it. It threw ReferenceError: dir is not defined on every invocation; goldScalpSetups has an outer catch { return [] } and swallowed it, so the desk silently produced an empty board. That single throw was the shared cause of 18 red suites. The bundle runs BEFORE any direction exists - it gathers evidence for every strategy - so it cannot make a direction-dependent decision. The read is now stamped NEUTRAL and says it is context only, because claiming "Macro alignment" while stamping neutral asserted a check nobody performed. The duplicate macro read in the Confluence Tallying block (the second home for one piece of evidence) is removed rather than repaired. Recorded in the code that the direction-aware macro veto is STILL UNWIRED: hgGoldInstFilter, which does receive the candidate side, never reads dxyTrend or us10yTrend. Also: gold-candle-forecast.js anchors its direct PAXG fallback through the one home (gold-iux.js), as goldscalp.js and getGoldCandles already do - PAXG is a token, not the metal, and an unanchored forecast would disagree with every other gold desk. And test-goldswing GOLD-group nav pin records candle-forecast in its actual position. ALSO CARRIES UPSTREAM hg-v1310 CANDLE PATTERNS (same id, merged): the forecast now names hammer, shooting star, dragonfly and gravestone doji, marubozu, engulfing, piercing, dark cloud, harami, morning and evening star, three white soldiers, three black crows, tweezers and three inside; a pattern high or low is the stop only when it sits 0.25 to 2.5 ATR from the close, and a tape with no majority stays neutral and prints no stop.

CANDLE FORECAST gains an ADVANCED PATTERN LAYER - disclosure, not weight. New named patterns: bullish and bearish three-line strike, three outside up/down, abandoned baby (the only star that requires a real gap), rising and falling three methods, tasuki gap, side-by-side white lines, three-bar climax, and double inside/outside compression-expansion runs. Plus the accuracy half: a LOCATION AND DRIFT CONTEXT for whatever printed - where the pattern sat in the recent 20-bar range and whether the drift there runs with or against it - because a hammer at a swing low and the same hammer at a swing high are not the same event and the three-bar voter above cannot tell them apart. IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT VOTE. hgCfCandlePatterns DOES vote - its families add to bulls/bears and its stops become the trade stop - so a new voting family would silently double the live pattern weight (the hg-v966 trap) and could re-count a three-bar pattern the voter already counted (hg-v1153). Every name here is RECORDED and rides the result as advancedPatterns/patternLeans/patternWhere/patternDrift; nothing gates, scores or prices on it, and the guard asserts textually and behaviourally that no advanced value reaches bulls, bears, checked or rawStop. Found while building it: the layer read .length before validating its input, so a null tape threw - now it fails open to null. MERGED WITH UPSTREAM hg-v1311 (same id): upstream independently reached the same insight - a candle shape only votes when the prior swing agrees, because a hammer after a decline is long while the same shape after a rise is a hanging man - and wired it into the VOTE, adding sweeps, outside bars, belt holds, kickers, meeting lines and three methods as voting families. Both packs are on this tree; the advanced layer stays non-voting and its guard pins that invariant.

CANDLE FORECAST gains the GAPS AND WINDOWS family - the largest blind spot left, and the one that matters most for setup formation. The classic set in this file has forty-odd shapes and NOT ONE of them read a gap as a gap: the two-bar and three-bar voters compare bodies, wicks and containment, so a window (a bar whose whole range sits clear of the previous bars range) was invisible unless it happened to form an engulfing or a tasuki pattern on top of it. Added: the gap on the last bar CLASSIFIED BY STAGE from the size of the run-up in ATRs - breakaway under 1.5 ATR (a move is starting), runaway to 4 (a move is running), exhaustion beyond that (the gap is the last gasp) - plus an explicit exhaustion line, the ISLAND REVERSAL (gapped in, held clear, gapped back out; the strongest structure in the family and previously undetectable), the THREE-BAR REVERSAL (a failed breakout of the first bars extreme, then a close beyond the other), and LADDER BOTTOM/TOP. The stage is what tells a reader whether to enter or stand down, which is why the gap is classified rather than merely named. DISCLOSURE, NOT WEIGHT, as with the rest of this layer: nothing here votes, and the guard asserts the gap stage never reaches bulls, bears, checked or rawStop. Two real defects were found and fixed while measuring the new code: the gap check fired on an EARLIER bars window and so reported a stale gap as a fresh one, and the island directions were chained with else, which silently suppressed the bearish island whenever the bullish test also ran. Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-advanced.mjs now 35 assertions over 7 sections.

CANDLE FORECAST now reads WHAT THE OTHER GOLD DESKS READ - a confluence, and a setup formed from it. Until now the tab could name a pattern, a side, a stop and two targets and read NOTHING else: no indicators, no core strategies, no fundamentals. It could call a long on a hammer while the entire gold stack pointed the other way and had no way to know. hgCfConfluence composes the SHARED readers rather than re-deriving anything (hg-v949 one home): CANDLES from the forecast pattern layer, TECHNICALS from hgGoldIndicatorReads (the same indicator bag the desks read - SMA 20/50 stack, RSI vs 50, time-series momentum, linreg slope, Kaufman efficiency, Bollinger %B), STRATEGIES from hgGoldCatalogEngine (the Master Catalog frame, with its USED/UNCHECKED counts), and FUNDAMENTALS from hgFundamentalRegime GOLD (the shared fundamental stack). Volatility regime and volume ratio are disclosed as CONTEXT and never voted, because a quiet tape is not bullish. THE VOTE IS A COUNT OF INDEPENDENT FAMILIES, NEVER A SCORE: no score, weight, points or rating appears in the composer, and the setup reports "N families with the call, K against". A ticket needs a named candle pattern, two independent families with the call, and none against; anything short prints CONFLUENCE READ - NOT A TICKET with the reason. UNREAD IS NEVER AGREEMENT: a dark feed votes unread and is named in a missing-readers line, so it can neither make a ticket easier nor harder. The Master Catalog frame never votes a side - inventing a direction from "93 indicators are USED" would be exactly the unmeasured weight this desk refuses (hg-v966). Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-confluence.mjs - 38 assertions over 7 sections, including all four families voting with the readers present, two readers absent voting unread rather than with, a NEUTRAL candle read confluencing nothing, and the composer never throwing.

CANDLE FORECAST: the confluence now hands the fundamental stack the HOUSE MACRO SNAPSHOT, and the card states whether it was read. The first cut passed an empty options bag, so hgFundamentalRegime ran with no extra and the macro PRIORS (DXY, US10Y, GSR) read unread even when the snapshot was cached. getGoldMacroCached is the accessor every gold desk already reads (macro.js exports it), so this composes the existing snapshot and fetches nothing new - a display tab must not trigger a network round-trip, and a cold snapshot still reads unread, which is the honest state. The card now prints "Macro snapshot: read" or "not cached this scan, so the fundamental family reads UNREAD (never counted as agreement)". MEASURED ON REAL GOLD (Binance XAUUSDT, 200 x 15m bars, last close 4189.68): the tab REFUSED a ticket, which is the feature working. The candle read was BULL - a bullish harami plus a low sweep reclaimed, at the range low, 4 reads for and 1 against - and the STRUCTURE read was the other way (a bearish fair value gap and a bearish order block held), so the engine formed NO setup, and the confluence reported 1 family AGAINST the call. Before this feature the tab would have printed that long with a stop and two targets and no idea the gold stack disagreed. The four DIRECTIONAL fundamental legs (real-rate, COT, gold F&G, PAXG positioning) need their own feed objects, which this tab deliberately does not fetch; the macro snapshot feeds the info priors. So the fundamental family votes when those feeds are supplied and reads unread otherwise, and unread is never counted as agreement.

CANDLE FORECAST confluence: FOUR MORE DISTINCT READS join the vote, taking the technical family from six to ten. The indicator bag publishes 35 keys and the composer voted six, so most of what the indicator desk derives never reached the confluence. Each addition answers a question the original six CANNOT: SQUEEZE RELEASE (a state change, not a level or slope - ON means energy stored and no side yet, so it abstains rather than guessing, and no direction is claimed unless goldVolSqueeze actually published one), DMI SPREAD (+DI vs -DI, directional movement measured bar by bar rather than a stack or a slope), HURST (is the tape trending or mean-reverting - a trend read only means something if there is a trend to read) and RETURN AUTOCORRELATION (does the last return predict the next; lag-1 on returns, where Hurst is a scaled-range estimate - related estimators, not the same one). All four are three-state, so a dark feed abstains rather than voting with or against, and the Hurst / ACF raw values ride beside the votes as disclosure. Verified on real gold (200 x 15m XAUUSDT bars): ten technical voters, DMI voting WITH, squeeze correctly UNREAD while compressed, Hurst and ACF unread because their feed is the daily session - and the tab still refused a ticket because no named candle pattern formed.

CANDLE FORECAST: EVERY GOLD DESK NOW VOTES, driven on the same tape. A fifth family joins the confluence. The four families before this read SHARED series. hgCfDeskVotes asks the more direct question: what did each gold TABs OWN desk engine actually FORM on these identical bars? GOLD SCALP, GOLD SWING, GOLD PINE and GANESH GOLD are each called with the same rows, and the side a desk FORMED is its vote - more long candidates than short reads WITH a long call, more shorts reads AGAINST, and a desk that formed NOTHING reads UNREAD. That last rule matters most here: most desks form nothing on any given tape by design, and counting silence as agreement would manufacture a quorum out of nothing. ONE DESK COUNTS ONCE however many candidates it minted, so a chatty engine cannot outvote a quiet one (hg-v966), and a desk carrying an exactly even split abstains rather than tossing a coin. An engine that is missing is named "not loaded on this page" and one that throws is named with its CAUSE - "loaded and formed nothing" and "could not read its feed" are different facts about the tape and a reader must be able to tell them apart. VERIFIED ON REAL GOLD (Binance XAUUSDT 15m, last close 4195.29): the candle read was BULL on a bullish engulfing; GOLD SCALP formed 3 long / 0 short and voted WITH; GOLD SWING, GOLD PINE and GANESH GOLD formed nothing and read unread; technicals were 6 with / 0 against / 4 unread. Five families, three with the call and none against, on a named pattern - so the tab formed a CONFLUENCE SETUP. The same run refused the setup on the previous tape, which is the behaviour that matters: it forms when the desks agree and stands down when they do not. Tests: tests/test-candle-forecast-desk-votes.mjs - 27 assertions over 6 sections, pinning the silence-is-not-agreement rule, one-desk-one-vote against a fifty-candidate engine, the split-desk abstention, the fail-open paths with the cause reported, and the NEUTRAL-read case.

CANDLE FORECAST now prints a SCALP setup AND a SWING setup, not one unlabelled bracket. A 15m read and a 4h read are different trades - the scalp lives or dies inside a session, the swing rides a move for days - and the tab used to show a single set of levels with no statement of which horizon they belonged to. Both are built now, each on its own tape and each carrying its OWN ATR, because risk has to be measured on the timeframe the trade is taken on. The card states plainly that a scalp stop and a swing stop in dollars are not the same risk. ONE HOME, TWO INSTANCES (hg-v949): a single builder, hgCfBuildSetup, produces both brackets - the tab calls it twice with a different tape rather than carrying two copies of the maths, so the two horizons stay comparable and cannot drift apart. The builder is PURE and TAPE-DRIVEN: it fetches nothing, which keeps the horizon a bracket describes independent of any network call. The tab owns the fetching and its loader is now parameterised by timeframe (one chain: house loader -> XAU -> IUX-anchored PAXG) rather than hard-wired to 15m, so the 4h swing tape comes from the SAME feed order. A bracket that DID NOT FORM still reports its risk in ATRs - a declined call still has a bracket to weigh - and is explicitly never labelled a setup. An unread 4h tape is named and the scalp is unaffected. TESTS: tests/test-candle-forecast-two-horizons.mjs, 28 assertions over 5 sections. Building it surfaced three faults, all in the GUARD and none in the code: a non-greedy lift that swallowed the function opening brace, a helper list missing hgCfStructure / aAdvance / hgCfGoldDesk (the engine catch turns a missing helper into return null, so it did not fail loudly), and a fixture tape whose high sat below its low - which the engine correctly refused.
